benchmark.title: TabArena: A Living Benchmark for Machine Learning on Tabular Data
benchmark.authors: Nick Erickson, Lennart Purucker, Andrej Tschalzev, David Holzmueller, Prateek Mutalik Desai, David Salinas, Frank Hutter
benchmark.venue: NeurIPS 2025, Datasets and Benchmarks Track; arXiv:2506.16791v4 (3 Nov 2025)

selection_rule: OpenML suite 457 lists 51 tasks; 38 are Supervised Classification; the 30 whose target feature declares exactly two nominal values are kept. The same 30 are marked problem_type=binary in the repo's curated_tabarena_dataset_metadata.csv and carry the AUC metric in Table F.1.

counting_rules.row: a non-empty, non-comment line after @DATA with as many fields as declared attributes
counting_rules.missing: an unquoted '?' (the ARFF missing token). OpenML's feature records and the parquet nulls agree with this on every column.
counting_rules.pseudo_missing: literal values such as nan, unknown, Not Available are ordinary values in the files and are NOT counted as missing; they are tallied per column in measured-column-counts.csv
counting_rules.distinct: exact for nominal and STRING columns; for numeric columns exact up to 1000, else '>1000'

tools.downloader: curl (sequential, at most two retries, no credentials)

artifact_suites.tabarena-2025-06-12: all methods except Linear and KNN

not_acquired.reason: not needed for counting; public, one URL per dataset recorded under openml_split_file_url_NOT_DOWNLOADED
